description.en: Turns on the screen's out-of-focus blur ("boke") post-effect, fading it in to a given intensity over a number of frames.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Fade in the screen blur effect
CMND_BOKE_CREATE(0.89999998, 7.0);
